invariant: All product mutable state has one owner; share semantic algorithms and platform seams, never copy Tiny backend implementations.

modules.reason: Share exact ISA decode semantics between v2 and product. Keep a v2 adapter; no copy-pasted second decoder.
Move backend-neutral interpreted instruction semantics once; adapt result to v2 RobDispatch and product decoded bundle separately.
Shared semantic DecodedInstruction/operation enums should be defined outside v2, while product RobToken/physical identities get independent widths and contracts.
Reuse ISA/software-target logic, but add a separate product-core capability gate. Do not advertise F/D in v2 CoreConfig.
Only order/lifetime owner; no wide ROB4 age projection. Include arbitrary-age recovery and 1-2-wide retirement interface.
Explicit speculative/committed RAT, stale-pdst undo metadata and FreeList, not scoreboard values in ROB.
IQ owns bounded wait entries only; receives slim tags and ready bits, no all-wide ROB broadcast MUX.
Reuse arithmetic algorithms through independent tagged request/response wrappers; do not hardwire TinyRobGeometry widths.
Replace single exact-head LSU ownership; speculative Load and commitment of Store/SC/AMO are explicit, not inherited mutable policies.
No subclass last-connect or hardcoded 0/1/2 external txn namespace; independent LSQ/transport response tables.
One selectable product pipeline and the same-source G1/G2/G3 presets; old paged core remains qualified reference.
Reuse privileged CSR meanings through explicit ordered Commit effect adapter, no CSR mutation at speculative FU completion.
Reuse Sv39/PMP translation as a typed customer, later ensure PTW observes dirty D-cache PTE and replay/flush.
Keep AetherMemRequest/Response and PMA separation. Product transport owns live TxnId, ROB owns RobToken.
v0 complex remains unchanged; later opt-in adapter to identical semantic memory, IRQ and instruction trace seams.
No replacement until standalone product core Spike differential, memory ordering and board-neutral interface pass.
